_doc: ONE source for scoring/setup/direction rules shared by desk (TS), brain, Floor and desk-watcher (Python). Parity tests on both sides fail on drift. Change here, then copy to desk-watcher/watcher/desk-rules.json.

lateEntry._modelPricePendingDoc: Late card whose only latePnlCheck miss is a model price (no live chain quote): Floor keeps it ARMED with ticket.latePnlPending=true; the watcher runs entry_distance_check pnlMinPct on the live RH option quote before placing and refuses on a fail or a missing quote. A miss on a live quote still drops the ticket.

timing._doc: Fix B (Keaton 2026-10-14): q and band measure SETUP QUALITY only; distance from entry is entryState (at/near/late/missed + ATR distance on 1m-4h) shown on the card. live = discipline R3 chase no longer cuts q/band (and the brain retrace layer reads timing, not a must); shadow = old penalties applied, the quality-only q/band and entryState logged as shadow:timing rows. Execution gates unchanged: watcher entry_distance 0.5xATR, loss.late guard, lateEntry.pnlMinPct. A late/missed card proposes a re-entry only at a real POI on the wire (unmitigated FVG/IFVG CE on any rung 1m-4h, or the retest of the broken entry zone).

clear._doc: Fix A (Keaton 2026-10-14 09:55 ET): a kill clears (reason killCleared) once EVERY piece of its evidence is invalidated on CLOSED bars — bull IFVG closed back below lo / bear IFVG above hi / reversal level reclaimed — agreed by >= minRungs rungs and a majority of the rungs closed since the kill (1m-4h together; a lone 1m never clears). live = side re-arms (capped A-, same as rearmed); shadow = card reason + wire field only. Desk mtf-context killClearedOf; watcher ltf_kill reads the desk's ltfKilled/ltfKillCleared.

session._doc: RH blocks new 0DTE opens after 15:30 ET and force-closes 0DTE ~15:45 ET. From zeroDteCutoffEt only dte>=1 is picked; any 0DTE position is flattened by zeroDteFlatEt; everything is flat by flatByMaxEt (no overnight holds).

fast._doc: Fast-move layer (watcher aggregates 1s/5s/15s from the desk's live gateway price; the desk reads it via /api/desk/fast). SHADOW ONLY until the 1s replay proves an edge: shadow=true means no score/fire influence.

learning._doc: Brain/learning loop. Scoring changes are PROPOSALS: shadow-scored for shadowDays, then applied only on approval (POST /api/desk/journal/approve).

loss._doc: Loss-pattern guards (Keaton 2026-10-13, audit of 83 trades / 9 sessions). One source for desk, brain, Floor and watcher. See src/lib/smc/loss-guards.ts and watcher gates.loss_*.

htf._doc: 1h AND 4h both oppose the side: below A blocks; A/A- fire at sizeMult; A+ stays A+ only with a 5m/15m sweep plus displacement, else capped to A (size cut). While mode=shadow the watcher runs the legacy htf gate: one of 1h/4h opposing = size cut; both opposing = legacyBothOppose ("block" | "sizeCut"; audit: block +7.47R vs size cut +9.53R vs none +11.58R on 83 trades → sizeCut).

early._doc: No minR of favourable excursion within minutes after the fill: cut at market.

velocity._doc: Expected minutes to T1 = |T1-entry| / (60m range / 60). Above maxMin: q penalty.

stop._doc: Stop beyond the structural swing / sweep wick by bufferAtr x ATR15 OR the winners' MAE percentile (maePctAtr x ATR15), whichever is larger; the |entry-stop| floor stays minStopAtr.

late._doc: Entry more than maxAtr x ATR15 past the trigger level is late: only the full lateEntry rule (A+/A/A-, ARMED, RR from price, option PnL) may fire it.

chop._doc: 60m range < rangeAtr x ATR15, 5m overlap > overlap, failed 5m breaks of the 60m range >= failedBreaks; needScore of 3 => chop: band capped at capBand (B = never fires; watch row).

target._doc: T1 must be a ranked liquidity draw (rankDraws, rank >= minRank) — SD/session fallbacks are T2 only. At beFrac of the way to T1 the stop moves to breakeven. mode = the ranked-T1 rule (6a); beMode = the breakeven rule (6b).

option._doc: Projected option net at T1 = |delta| x move x ratio - theta/min x expected minutes - spread must be > minNet (premium $ per share). From preferDte1MinLeftMin minutes before session.zeroDteCutoffEt pick dte>=1. Never past session.flatByMaxEt.

loss._modes: Per-rule mode (Keaton 2026-10-13 13:45 CT): "live" acts; "shadow" computes and logs what it would do (card wire.strategy.guards.shadow, watcher gates.log shadow:* rows) and changes nothing (q, band, size, stop, watch row, brain word, fire).

optExec._doc: Option-PnL fixes 1-20 (Keaton 2026-10-13). One source for desk (src/lib/execution/opt-exec.ts), Floor ticket and watcher (watcher/optexec.py). mode live = acts; shadow = logged as shadow:opt:* rows in gates.log only. Entry-restricting rules (6,12,16,19) and size/re-entry/spread rules start shadow until the backtest (tools/slim_backtest.py) proves them.

dteByTime._why: backtest: 0DTE AM / 1DTE PM -$17/wk vs 1DTE all day (model IV); shadow until recorded chains say otherwise

timeStop._why: backtest 2026-09-16..10-12 (slim B+ p2, 29 fires): live time stop -$44/wk vs without; shadow until recorded chains say otherwise

dayGovernor._doc: Fix 19 governor (after |R| >= absR on the day, A+ only). Bug 2026-10-13: it read PAPER journal R (card outcomes sampled at card reads, never traded) and also locked on a +2R paper day; today -3.76R paper locked every non-A+ card while 0 real fires. shadow = reported on wire.day only, never touches actionable. Real stops: watcher daily cap + weekly lock.

weekly._doc: Weekly profit lock (Keaton 2026-10-13, LIVE; only restricts). Week = Mon-Fri ET, realized option PnL from RH fills on the Agentic account (read-only). At >= lockTarget: A+ only, lockedMaxContracts / lockedMaxDebit. Locked and PnL <= peak x (1 - givebackPct): no new entries for the week. PnL <= lossLock: no new entries for the week.

fastChain._doc: FAST-SETUPS-ONLY fire chain (Keaton 2026-10-13, live from 2026-10-14). Hard: safety stops (account/position/working order/live quote/sizing/BP/tape/card age/news/entry cutoff/daily cap/weekly lock/rules parity/kill switch/flat by) + band from q >= minBand held continuously for minHoldS seconds (same symbol/side, plan valid) + plan (entry, stop, real T1 on the correct sides, R:R >= rrMin, price within entryAtr x ATR of entry) + agreement (brain not on the opposite side; 1h+4h not both against) + fast (T1 <= maxMinutesToT1 at the card's velocity). Every other gate is a soft:* row (logged, never blocks). Trim trimFrac at firstTargetR (underlying), stop to breakeven after the trim, rest to T1/T2. Debit spread when a single option does not fit the band's $ cap.
fastChain.geometryDoc: fast:geometry (Floor review 19:28 ET 2026-10-13): long needs stop<entry<T1(<T2), short stop>entry>T1(>T2), on the plan stop AND the management stop; traded ticket type/ETF = card side/symbol; a desk Floor ticket whose call/put disagrees with the card side refuses.

kzDisp._doc: Kill-zone opening-displacement detector (Keaton 2026-10-13, items 1-50). Every item starts mode=shadow: logged as shadow:kz:* ok rows, never changes band/fire/plan. Promote only when tools/kz_backtest.py shows hit/R/freq not worse on 6-12 months; see tools/kz_backtest_report.json. Twin: watcher/killzone.py, desk src/lib/desk/kz-disp.ts.

fireFix._doc: Make-top-cards-fire fixes (Keaton 2026-10-13 evening). mode live = acts, shadow = logged as shadow:fx:* rows only. Restrictions and size-ups start shadow; promoted only when tools/replay_fx.py shows win rate, R, option PnL and fires/week not worse. Band edges are rise-only and unchanged here. Safety stops (account, position, working order, live quote, BP, tape, card age, news, entry cutoff, daily cap, weekly lock, rules parity, kill switch, flat-by) stay hard.

deadZone._doc: q clamped by BAND_CEIL (qRaw > q) is not a near miss: no NEAR MISS alert; pre-clamp q logged as q_raw in gates.log.

rulesPin._doc: First card hash seen in a session is pinned; a card with a different hash later that day fails rules_pin (deploys land outside RTH).

soleBlocker._doc: status.json and the desk Watcher tab show the single failing hard gate of the top card (or the count when several fail).

bplusWindow._doc: B+ entries refused at/after lastEt ET.

riskCap._doc: Max debit = equity x equityPct / stopLossFrac (loss at the option stop <= 25% of equity). Equity = RH buying power + open cost.

sizeToFit._doc: Over the cap: delta 0.45-0.50, then next expiry, then a 1-wide debit spread, then SPY for QQQ; skip only if none fit.

htfOneStep._doc: ONE of 1h/4h opposing = caps of the next band down (A+ -> A caps, A -> A-, A- -> B+); BOTH opposing keeps loss.htf.

upsize._doc: A-/B+ cap rises to maxDebit when projected T1 option value >= minT1Mult x (theta to T1 + spread).

persistGrace._doc: fast:persist hold survives one card whose q dips under minBand while price is still within entryAtr of entry.

nearMissFire._doc: q in [qMin, B+ edge): fire 1 contract when fast, brain same side, Floor ARMED/WATCH not STAND, 1h+4h not both against.

reentry._doc: After a clean stop (no trim), one re-entry same symbol/side if band >= minBand and the second-entry rule passes.

restingLimit._doc: Armed card: resting limit at FVG/OB entry, cancelled after maxMin. Shadow logs the would-fill only.

bplusFloor._doc: B+ debit cap floor (B+ $150 is under ATM 1DTE SPY $189-214).

gateHand._doc: Desk gateHand: brain/SMT/direction holds on A+/A hand to the watcher with sizeCut (one band step) instead of WATCH; B+/A- keep WATCH. Watcher: brain STAND/WAIT on A+/A = one-step size cut.

costGate._doc: Option cost gate = optExec.t1VsCost (T1 option value >= 2x theta+spread). Mode mirrored into optExec.t1VsCost.

envelope._doc: ONE debit envelope for desk (RH_MAX_DEBIT_TOTAL) and watcher (A+ $650 band cap). Was $550 desk vs $650 watcher.

dayLoss._doc: Strictest daily loss cap: min($usd, desk APLUS dailyLossLimitPct 0.15 x equity) of realized option PnL today -> no new entries (watcher day_loss, hard). Weekly -$300 loss lock (weekly.lossLock) stays live.

oneLotT1._doc: 1 contract: full exit at T1 (watcher manage parity with paper-manager.ts).

ladder._doc: Keaton 2026-10-13 18:29 CT: debit cap $650 for EVERY grade (desk RH_MAX_DEBIT_TOTAL = envelope.maxDebit 650); max contracts stay the grade ladder (A+ 4 / A 2 / A- 1 / B+ 1). Single options only (fastChain.spreadFallback=false, sizeToFit.spread=false). $50 floor, BP gate, daily loss cap and -$300 weekly lock unchanged.

ltfArm._doc: LTF arm (Keaton 2026-10-14): closed-bar sweep -> displacement -> IFVG/FVG -> CISD/MSS on 1m-5m and 15m arms the side the raid arms. mode shadow: recorded on the card (ltfArm/ltfArmShadow) and in watcher gates.log shadow:kz rows, changes nothing. mode live: adds the evidence to the card, releases the extension guard, lets smc-canon sweep/POI pass, T1 falls back to the next real pool; any card that needed LTF evidence is capped at capBand. Band edges untouched. All-timeframe rule (Keaton 2026-10-14): arming and kills read every closed rung 1m-4h; no rule depends on one timeframe. Kill IFVG age is in minutes (kill.ifvg5MaxAge x 5m) on every rung.

smcUnity._doc: SMC/unity audit 2026-10-14 (audits/smc-unity-audit-2026-10-14.md). Every item is shadow: computed, logged on wire.smcUnity / watcher shadow:smc:* rows, changes nothing (q, band, actionable, brain word, Floor verdict, fire). Band edges untouched (rise-only). Depends on fix/stale-veto-q-timing (kill.clear, timing) and feat/ltf-arm (1m-5m arming) — does not duplicate them.

ifvgFail._doc: F1: an IFVG that CLOSES back through its origin side (bull IFVG close < lo, bear IFVG close > hi) is a failed inversion: row.failed=true, it no longer kills; killT anchors to the inversion time (F7).

continuation._doc: F2: while the side's structure holds on >= minRungs closed rungs (same-dir FVGs holding, opposite IFVGs failing, lower highs/higher lows), the card rolls T1 to the next real liquidity beyond price (>= minR from the new POI) and re-anchors entry to the newest unmitigated same-direction array formed after the last BOS on any rung; pd_half is judged at the POI inside the latest leg; the late guard measures from that POI; same-leg continuation is not a 'second entry'.

killzoneLive._doc: F3: watcher runs killzone.detect each closed 1m bar in nyAm/nyPm without lookahead (shadow:kz rows); taps read arrays on 1m-1h.

brainPerBook._doc: F4: a brain STAND/side on a different book than the ticket is a caution, not a block.

extensionMtf._doc: F8: extension guard accepts closed reversal evidence on any rung 1m-30m; caps at A- instead of skip.

feedClock._doc: F9: closed-bar tests use the series' feed time (marketTimeMs), not the server clock; a 1m series older than minuteMaxStaleS never feeds kills, re-arms or LTF structure.

floorDte._doc: F10: intraday SMT/killzone tickets take optExec.dteByTime (0DTE before zeroDteUntilEt) instead of a fixed 5 DTE.

ranges._doc: F11/Keaton: premium/discount per rung on that rung's own dealing range (last confirmed swing high to swing low on closed bars), session ranges (Asia/London/NY OR/Overnight) from closed 1m by feed time, bounded to ONE trading session with an 18:00 ET roll (also gates structure.ts session buckets: live = current session only, shadow = legacy 200-bar lookback); the impulse leg is anchored on the newest multi-rung sweep, not a 15m-only one.

bothKills._doc: F12: two live opposite kills are both reported (each side killed), not null.

deskSeq._doc: Keaton's trade sequence (audits/desk-sequence-brief-2026-10-14.md fixes 1-10). Every item is shadow: computed on wire.deskSeq, logged by the watcher as shadow:seq:<rule>, changes nothing (q, band, actionable, brain word, Floor verdict, fire). Band edges untouched (rise-only); the 650 USD cap and daily/weekly locks are not read or written. Closed bars by feed time only; session ranges one session with an 18:00 ET roll; other book = different symbol only.

brainBooks._doc: F5: brain words per book x side; Floor/master/grok_agree read the ticket book+side. A STAND/WAIT on a DIFFERENT symbol is a caution, not a block; same symbol opposite side is never weakened.

pdLeg._doc: F6: pd_half judged at the POI inside the dealing leg (manipulation extreme to the extreme since, closed 1m by feed time), EQ band = no edge; EQ stack = prior session (PDH/PDL), this session, Asia, London, NY OR, overnight (one session each, 18:00 ET roll). Shadow: never flips the legacy must.

premarketMap._doc: F1: premarket map per book frozen at 09:25 ET from closed bars: arrays FVG/IFVG/sponsored on 1m-4h + 1D, OB/breaker/rejection on 5m-4h + 1D (CE + edges, live/failed), kept within windowAtr x ATR15 of price, nearest maxPerTf per tf/kind/dir; PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, D-2..D-(olderSessions+1) session highs/lows, Asia/London/premarket/overnight H/L, midnight + 18:00 opens; EQH/EQL pools (5m/15m, tol eqTolAtr x ATR15, unswept, nearest maxPools/2 per side); dealing range = prior session + overnight with EQ; bias per rung 1m-1D + HTF/MTF/LTF stack; AMD phase + expected manipulation side. 30s listed missing (not synthesized). Keaton 10/14: unswept fractal swings on 15m-1D are ranked pools; lows are only short targets and highs only long targets (a broken PDL is never buyside); T1 = nearest LIQUIDITY clearing minR before array edges; EQH/EQL from eqPools.

amd._doc: F4: AMD state machine per book 09:30-11:00 ET on closed bars: WATCH -> MANIP (a 1m wick takes a mapped level/pool or a live opposing 15m-1D array beyond the open; a new raid needs a new extreme; only ENTERED setups count toward maxPerSide) -> CONFIRM (body close on any closed rung 1m/2m/3m/5m/15m back through the last swing (CHoCH) or through a raid-direction gap (inversion), displacement body >= dispAtr x ATR1m x sqrt(tf)) -> ARMED (entry = CE of the newest unfilled displacement gap 1m-5m after the extreme, else the displacement OB; stop = beyond the extreme + stopBufAtr15 x ATR15; T1 = nearest real mapped level/pool/array edge clearing minR (map targets + RTH extremes printed before the raid); risk >= minRiskAtr15 x ATR15) -> ENTERED (later bar trades the entry). Invalid: accepted beyond the raided level (a run) -> WATCH; T1 before fill = MISSED; fillMin/confirmMin expire. Late is a transition, never a decaying score. Shadow. Defaults chosen walk-forward on the first 75% of 19 Yahoo sessions (confirm on 2m+ closes, stop buffer 0.15 x ATR15, minR 1.25): train 41 tr 48.8% +0.12R, holdout 13 tr 53.8% +0.33R.

continuation._doc: F9: after an AMD ENTER, while structure holds (not both the last closed 5m and 15m closing beyond the last 5m swing against the trade) T1 rolls to the next real mapped pool/level beyond the printed one (labelled), entry re-anchors to the newest unmitigated same-side 1m-30m gap after the fill, stop beyond the last 5m swing + stopBufAtr15 x ATR15, T1 >= minR; armed only in regime trend (2 consecutive closed 15m bars beyond the session open, hysteresis); not a second entry (own maxPerSide); until endEtMin ET. Keaton 10/14: a body close through a mapped sellside/buyside level beyond the RTH open also opens continuation (bosParents); entry = the tallest unmitigated gap of the breaking leg (re-anchor only after a new extreme); stop = CE of the nearest live opposing 5m-1h gap beyond entry within maxStopAtr15 (gapCeStop), else the 5m swing; regime anchored on the 18:00 ET session open.

intradayExec._doc: F10: (a) AMD/continuation intraday tickets use optExec.dteByTime (0DTE before zeroDteUntilEt, never past session.zeroDteCutoffEt) on the book ETF (MNQ->QQQ, ES->SPY) at a live cross ratio (ETF and future quotes within maxCrossSkewS by feed time), model strikes refused; the 5DTE swing card stays separate. (b) every rung 1m/2m/3m/5m/15m judges its last CLOSED bar (feed time) per mapped array: wick = sweep/tap, body close = respect/fail; minute series older than maxStaleS -> stale, LTF decisions refused.

eqPools._doc: EQH/EQL audit fix: fractal-2 swings confirmed by closed bars on every rung 1m-1D, tol max(tolTicks x tick, eqTolAtr x rung ATR), minTouches, pool price = the extreme, age cap per rung; first later wick beyond = USED (kept as evidence, never a target/draw/raid). Feeds the premarket map pools/levels, T1 ranking, AMD sweep detection (intraday 1m/5m pools), wire rows (brain) and shadow:seq:eqPools (watcher).

scenarios._doc: F2: four scripted open plays per book from the 09:25 map (S1-bear sweep high->reverse->invert->lower draws; S2-bear sweep low->gap+consolidate->CE retrace->down; S1-bull/S2-bull mirrors) with trigger, invalidation, real draws; ranked by prior (F7 odds when scenarioOdds.lr is set). Yahoo 19 sessions x2: top-2 hit 52.6% (holdout 60%), target 70%.

respect._doc: F3: respect ledger per book from 09:30 ET on closed bars: first touch of each live mapped/intraday array scored by the touching bar body close (held +1 / failed -1) per tier LTF/MTF/HTF; stronger side when |net| >= minNet. Yahoo: next-30-min direction hit 58.9% (holdout 60%), target 65%.

scenarioOdds._doc: F7: P(script) = train base rate x likelihood ratios of map features (fitLr, Laplace, train sessions only). Holdout Brier 0.607 vs 0.532 base-rate-only and 0.703 heuristic prior: does NOT beat the base rate; lr table not shipped.

calibrate._doc: F8: isotonic score(T1 R:R)->P(win) fitted on train AMD trades; E[R]=p*RR-(1-p); shadow gate minEdgeR. Holdout: kept 13/15, win 38.5%, no improvement; P>=0.65 bucket 0/2. Table not shipped (no calibrated edge).

sessionGateStudy._doc: Keaton: session gate refusals (out of 08:30-11:00 / 13:30-16:00 ET, shock exception 2.0xATR & 1.5xvol unchanged). Continuation run all day on Yahoo 19 sessions x2: lunch refusals 15 trades 40% win -0.083R -576 USD/wk; HTF-aligned & >=4 rungs 7 trades -0.246R; others 8 trades +0.059R -146 USD/wk. No bucket positive after costs: no exception proposed; live thresholds unchanged.

primaryHysteresis._doc: Review 2026-10-15 #3: ES/MNQ primary-card hysteresis. The challenger takes primary only after out-scoring the incumbent by margin for polls consecutive REAL polls (the same upstream fetch rebuilt is the same poll and does not tick); on a lead re-grade keepOtherBook restores the non-lead book. shadow = desk primary, candidate order and both books exactly as main; the hysteresis pick and what keepOtherBook would change are only logged on wire.primaryHysteresis. live = acts.
